descripcion: At A2 you learn the most basic everyday phrasal verbs: get up, sit down, come in. These are used constantly in daily instructions and conversation. More varied phrasal verbs, with their prepositions, come at higher levels.

ejemplos.texto: I get up at seven every morning.

notas: These phrasal verbs are extremely common in everyday instructions.
Get up, sit down and come in cannot be split in these simple forms.
They're used constantly at home, school and work.

contraste.es: El español no tiene phrasal verbs, así que estas combinaciones se aprenden como bloques nuevos, sin equivalente estructural directo.

errores: Forgetting the second word of the phrasal verb.
Translating word for word from a verb in your own language.
autochequeo: Have I used at least three phrasal verbs?
Is the second word of each phrasal verb present?
promptCorreccion: Focus only on the basic phrasal verbs. Check that both words are present in each one. Do not rewrite the text. Flag anything unclear. Flag any word-for-word translation from Spanish.
